recipes.name: Pomegranate tea (Seoklyu-cha)
instructions: Place the pomegranate seeds in a bowl. Crush them coarsely with a pestle about 50 to 60 times.
Add the sugar and mix well.
Put the mixture in a glass jar. Make tea right away, or keep in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

instruction_sections.text: Place the pomegranate seeds in a bowl. Crush them coarsely with a pestle about 50 to 60 times.
Add the sugar and mix well.
Put the mixture in a glass jar. Make tea right away, or keep in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.
Put about ¼ cup of pomegranate seeds and juice in a tea cup. Add hot water and mix. Serve hot.
